findings.body: The new override forces production installs to node-forge 1.4.1. The maintainer's [GHSA-3cc4-3294-vgjf advisory](https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge/security/advisories/GHSA-3cc4-3294-vgjf), published November 4, identifies versions through 1.4.2 as affected by a HIGH-severity certificate-validation vulnerability and fixes it in 1.4.3. This is newer evidence than the documented 1.4.1 remediation. Update the override and lockfile to a patched version so this change does not lock its production dependency below the fix required by the image-vulnerability policy.
findings.title: Pin node-forge to a version containing the current HIGH-severity fix
